$comment: Data-driven registry for the release-bundle orchestrator (.github/workflows/release-bundle.yml). Each entry is one evidence signal run against the ONE release-candidate AOT image. `mode` controls how the orchestrator obtains the evidence; `imageInput` names the workflow_dispatch input (or env var) that pins the suite to the RC image ref/digest. Suites with "refactorPending": true do NOT yet accept the prebuilt image and are reported as not-yet-gated until refactored (foundation-first; see docs/contributor/release-bundle.md). Add suites here to widen the gate.

integration.name: Real-Client Interop Matrix
integration.requirement: Real GIS clients (GDAL, PyQGIS, OpenLayers, Cesium, ArcGIS stub) green against the RC image.

integration.name: Esri SDK Certification
integration.requirement: License-free official Esri SDKs (arcgis Python, @arcgis/core, ArcGIS .NET) certify against the RC image.

integration.name: GeoServices Parity
integration.requirement: Esri GeoServices latency/transfer-limit parity holds against the RC image.

integration.name: PyQGIS Client Compatibility
integration.requirement: Real QGIS/PyQGIS OGC API + WFS compatibility against the RC image.

integration.name: OGC CITE Conformance
integration.requirement: OGC CITE suites (Features/Tiles/WFS/WMS/WMTS/WCS/GML/KML/GeoPackage) at 100%. Builds its own image today; needs a reusable-template image input to consume the RC image.

integration.name: Server integration tests
integration.requirement: ci.yml integration/protocol test suite green on the candidate ref (branch protection prerequisite).

integration.name: Console live integration (admin surface)
integration.requirement: Honua Console live integration (Studio/Operate/Catalog) green against the RC image. Non-server id, so it lands as a repository lane on the admin surface; supersedes the archived honua-server-admin admin-docs lane.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.requirement: Dotnet SDK conformance green against the RC image; package builds (dry-run).

sdk.name: JS SDK
sdk.requirement: JS SDK integration green against the RC image URL; package builds (dry-run).

sdk.name: Python SDK
sdk.requirement: Python SDK conformance green against the RC image; package builds (dry-run). Closes the local-fallback gap (honua-sdk-python#50).

sdk.name: Mobile SDK train
sdk.requirement: Mobile consumes the current .NET SDK train and smoke-tests against the RC image.

sdk.name: gRPC protocol contract
sdk.requirement: Proto contract package builds (dry-run); conformance fixtures versioned with the schema.

repositoryLanes.name: Helm chart RC metadata
repositoryLanes.requirement: Chart appVersion + image metadata point at the RC image.

repositoryLanes.name: Terraform modules
repositoryLanes.requirement: Terraform modules validate against the RC image tag.
